title: ZuCo 2.0: EEG and Eye-Tracking during Natural Reading and Annotation
description: ZuCo 2.0 provides simultaneous EEG and eye-tracking recordings from adult native English speakers during natural reading and annotation tasks. Participants performed normal reading and task-specific reading of Wikipedia sentences while 128-channel EEG and eye-tracking data were collected. The dataset supports research on the neural and oculomotor correlates of natural language processing and reading comprehension.
methods_description: 128-channel EEG (EGI Geodesic system, 500 Hz sampling rate, Cz reference) was recorded simultaneously with eye-tracking (EyeLink 1000, 500 Hz, left eye) while participants read naturalistic Wikipedia sentences under two conditions: normal reading and task-specific reading involving semantic relation annotation. Eye-tracking gaze and pupil samples are co-located with EEG recordings, and fixations, saccades, and blinks are provided in events files.
